problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,X\,$ | $\,Y\,$ | $\,X⇒(¬Y∨X)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
First, we add columns for $¬Y$ and $¬Y∨X:$

| $\,X\,$ | $\,Y\,$ | $\,¬Y\,$ | $\,¬Y∨X\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Now, we add a column for $X⇒(¬Y∨X).$ This statement is true unless $X$ is true and $¬Y∨X$ is false.

| $\,X\,$ | $\,Y\,$ | $\,¬Y\,$ | $\,¬Y∨X\,$ | $\,X⇒(¬Y∨X)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
